scope: fresh four-family task holdout within the frozen gpui-animated-gradient-text repository commit; two prompts per family; not cross-repository evidence
latency_definition: Sum of per-task observer-call elapsed times and deterministic authority time in the serial local harness; completion-test time is excluded because exact hash-verified pre-contact bank-build receipts were reused. p95 is descriptive with eight tasks, nearest-rank.
cost_definition: Local calls have zero billed API spend. Tokens and time are separate; energy and hardware-dollar cost were not measured.
heldout_label_access: An aborted score-only attempt opened labels before stopping on a receipt-reader schema mismatch. It wrote no lane results and changed no model outputs, bank, thresholds, or prompt. Corrected replay used the same frozen artifacts; no fitting or tuning followed label access.
